---
title: "湯水材料認字遊戲 iPad版"
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo
    page-layout: full
---

~~~~{=html}
<style>
body {
  background: #fff8ef;
  font-family: Arial, "Microsoft JhengHei", "PingFang HK", sans-serif;
}

.game-container {
  max-width: 1050px;
  margin: 25px auto;
  text-align: center;
}

.start-page {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 28px;
  padding: 70px 35px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  margin-top: 80px;
}

.start-title {
  font-size: 66px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #333;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.start-subtitle {
  font-size: 36px;
  color: #666;
  margin-bottom: 45px;
}

.start-button {
  font-size: 46px;
  font-weight: bold;
  padding: 25px 80px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: #ffb347;
  color: #222;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.start-button:hover {
  background: #ffa726;
}

.title {
  font-size: 48px;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  color: #333;
}

.progress {
  font-size: 28px;
  color: #666;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.card {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 28px;
  padding: 35px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

.soup-box {
  background: #fff0d6;
  border: 4px solid #ffb347;
  border-radius: 26px;
  padding: 35px 20px;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}

.soup-label {
  font-size: 28px;
  color: #666;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.soup-name {
  font-size: 58px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #222;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.instruction {
  font-size: 32px;
  color: #444;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.counter {
  font-size: 28px;
  color: #666;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.ingredients {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.ingredient-button {
  font-size: 30px;
  font-weight: bold;
  padding: 14px 10px 18px 10px;
  border: 4px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: #f8f8f8;
  color: #222;
  cursor: pointer;
  min-height: 215px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.ingredient-button:hover {
  background: #fff0d6;
}

.ingredient-image {
  width: 100%;
  height: 125px;
  object-fit: contain;
  border-radius: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  background: white;
}

.ingredient-word {
  display: block;
  font-size: 34px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.ingredient-button.correct {
  background: #92e6a7;
  border-color: #2b9348;
  color: #064b1c;
}

.ingredient-button.wrong {
  background: #ffadad;
  border-color: #d00000;
  color: #7b0000;
}

.ingredient-button.disabled {
  pointer-events: none;
}

.feedback {
  font-size: 36px;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-top: 25px;
  min-height: 50px;
}

.feedback.correct-text {
  color: #2b9348;
}

.feedback.wrong-text {
  color: #d00000;
}

.next-button {
  display: none;
  font-size: 34px;
  padding: 18px 55px;
  margin-top: 25px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: #ffb347;
  color: #222;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.next-button:hover {
  background: #ffa726;
}

.result-page {
  display: none;
  background: white;
  border-radius: 28px;
  padding: 55px 35px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  margin-top: 80px;
}

.result-title {
  font-size: 60px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #333;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}

.result-score {
  font-size: 46px;
  color: #2b9348;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.result-note {
  font-size: 30px;
  color: #666;
  margin-bottom: 35px;
}

.restart-button {
  font-size: 36px;
  padding: 20px 55px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: #ffb347;
  color: #222;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.restart-button:hover {
  background: #ffa726;
}

.summary {
  margin-top: 35px;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 26px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.summary-title {
  font-size: 34px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #333;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
  text-align: center;
}

.summary-item {
  background: #fff8ef;
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 15px 20px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.summary-soup {
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #222;
}

.summary-ingredients {
  color: #555;
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .ingredients {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }

  .soup-name {
    font-size: 44px;
  }

  .ingredient-button {
    min-height: 200px;
  }

  .ingredient-word {
    font-size: 30px;
  }

  .ingredient-image {
    height: 115px;
  }
}
</style>
~~~~

~~~~{=html}
<div class="game-container">

  <div class="start-page" id="start-page">
    <div class="start-title">湯水材料認字遊戲</div>
    <div class="start-subtitle">iPad版：睇圖揀材料</div>
    <button class="start-button" type="button" onclick="startGame()">開始</button>
  </div>

  <div id="game-page" style="display: none;">
    <div class="title">湯水材料認字遊戲</div>
    <div class="progress" id="progress">第 1 / 4 題</div>

    <div class="card">

      <div class="soup-box">
        <div class="soup-label">今日煲：</div>
        <div class="soup-name" id="soup-name"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="instruction">請揀出呢個湯嘅材料</div>
      <div class="counter" id="counter"></div>

      <div class="ingredients" id="ingredients"></div>

      <div class="feedback" id="feedback"></div>

      <button class="next-button" id="next-button" type="button" onclick="nextQuestion()">下一題</button>

    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="result-page" id="result-page">
    <div class="result-title">完成！</div>
    <div class="result-score" id="result-score"></div>
    <div class="result-note" id="result-note"></div>

    <button class="restart-button" type="button" onclick="restartGame()">再玩一次</button>

    <div class="summary" id="summary"></div>
  </div>

</div>
~~~~

~~~~{=html}
<script>
const soups = [
  {
    name: "青紅蘿蔔豬骨湯",
    ingredients: ["青蘿蔔", "紅蘿蔔", "豬骨", "蜜棗", "陳皮"]
  },
  {
    name: "合掌瓜粟米排骨湯",
    ingredients: ["合掌瓜", "粟米", "排骨", "紅蘿蔔", "蜜棗"]
  },
  {
    name: "木瓜雪耳湯",
    ingredients: ["木瓜", "雪耳", "瘦肉", "南北杏", "蜜棗"]
  },
  {
    name: "粉葛赤小豆湯",
    ingredients: ["粉葛", "赤小豆", "扁豆", "豬骨", "陳皮", "蜜棗"]
  }
];

const allIngredients = [
  { word: "青蘿蔔", image: "images/green-radish.jpg" },
  { word: "紅蘿蔔", image: "images/carrot.jpg" },
  { word: "豬骨", image: "images/pork-bones.jpg" },
  { word: "蜜棗", image: "images/honey-dates.jpg" },
  { word: "陳皮", image: "images/dried-tangerine-peel.jpg" },
  { word: "合掌瓜", image: "images/chayote.jpg" },
  { word: "粟米", image: "images/corn.jpg" },
  { word: "排骨", image: "images/pork-ribs.jpg" },
  { word: "木瓜", image: "images/papaya.jpg" },
  { word: "雪耳", image: "images/snow-fungus.jpg" },
  { word: "瘦肉", image: "images/lean-pork.jpg" },
  { word: "南北杏", image: "images/apricot-kernels.jpg" },
  { word: "粉葛", image: "images/kudzu-root.jpg" },
  { word: "赤小豆", image: "images/rice-beans.jpg" },
  { word: "扁豆", image: "images/hyacinth-beans.jpg" },
  { word: "花生", image: "images/peanuts.jpg" },
  { word: "冬瓜", image: "images/winter-melon.jpg" },
  { word: "節瓜", image: "images/hairy-gourd.jpg" },
  { word: "蓮藕", image: "images/lotus-root.jpg" },
  { word: "雞腳", image: "images/chicken-feet.jpg" },
  { word: "薏米", image: "images/jobs-tears.jpg" },
  { word: "無花果", image: "images/figs.jpg" },
  { word: "淮山", image: "images/chinese-yam.jpg" }
];

let questions = [];
let currentQuestionIndex = 0;
let perfectScore = 0;
let foundCorrect = 0;
let wrongClickedThisQuestion = false;
let clickedIngredients = [];

function shuffleArray(array) {
  const newArray = array.slice();

  for (let i = newArray.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    const temp = newArray[i];
    newArray[i] = newArray[j];
    newArray[j] = temp;
  }

  return newArray;
}

function startGame() {
  questions = shuffleArray(soups);
  currentQuestionIndex = 0;
  perfectScore = 0;

  document.getElementById("start-page").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("game-page").style.display = "block";
  document.getElementById("result-page").style.display = "none";

  showQuestion();
}

function showQuestion() {
  const currentSoup = questions[currentQuestionIndex];

  foundCorrect = 0;
  wrongClickedThisQuestion = false;
  clickedIngredients = [];

  document.getElementById("soup-name").textContent = currentSoup.name;

  document.getElementById("progress").textContent =
    "第 " + (currentQuestionIndex + 1) + " / " + questions.length + " 題";

  document.getElementById("counter").textContent =
    "已揀中 0 / " + currentSoup.ingredients.length + " 樣材料";

  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent = "";
  document.getElementById("feedback").className = "feedback";

  document.getElementById("next-button").style.display = "none";

  createIngredientButtons(currentSoup);
}

function createIngredientButtons(currentSoup) {
  const ingredientsDiv = document.getElementById("ingredients");
  ingredientsDiv.innerHTML = "";

  const correctIngredients = currentSoup.ingredients;

  const wrongPool = allIngredients.filter(function(item) {
    return correctIngredients.indexOf(item.word) === -1;
  });

  const correctObjects = allIngredients.filter(function(item) {
    return correctIngredients.indexOf(item.word) !== -1;
  });

  const numberOfWrongChoices = 12;
  const selectedWrongIngredients = shuffleArray(wrongPool).slice(0, numberOfWrongChoices);

  const displayedIngredients = shuffleArray(correctObjects.concat(selectedWrongIngredients));

  displayedIngredients.forEach(function(ingredientObj) {
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.className = "ingredient-button";
    button.type = "button";

    button.innerHTML =
      '<img class="ingredient-image" src="' + ingredientObj.image + '" alt="" onerror="this.style.visibility=\'hidden\';">' +
      '<span class="ingredient-word">' + ingredientObj.word + '</span>';

    button.onclick = function() {
      checkIngredient(button, ingredientObj.word, currentSoup);
    };

    ingredientsDiv.appendChild(button);
  });
}

function checkIngredient(button, ingredient, currentSoup) {
  if (clickedIngredients.indexOf(ingredient) !== -1) {
    return;
  }

  clickedIngredients.push(ingredient);

  const isCorrect = currentSoup.ingredients.indexOf(ingredient) !== -1;

  if (isCorrect) {
    button.classList.add("correct");
    button.classList.add("disabled");
    foundCorrect = foundCorrect + 1;

    document.getElementById("feedback").textContent = "啱！";
    document.getElementById("feedback").className = "feedback correct-text";
  } else {
    button.classList.add("wrong");
    button.classList.add("disabled");
    wrongClickedThisQuestion = true;

    document.getElementById("feedback").textContent = "呢樣唔係呢個湯嘅材料";
    document.getElementById("feedback").className = "feedback wrong-text";
  }

  document.getElementById("counter").textContent =
    "已揀中 " + foundCorrect + " / " + currentSoup.ingredients.length + " 樣材料";

  if (foundCorrect >= currentSoup.ingredients.length) {
    finishQuestion();
  }
}

function finishQuestion() {
  const allButtons = document.querySelectorAll(".ingredient-button");

  allButtons.forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.classList.add("disabled");
  });

  if (wrongClickedThisQuestion === false) {
    perfectScore = perfectScore + 1;

    document.getElementById("feedback").textContent = "全部揀啱晒！";
    document.getElementById("feedback").className = "feedback correct-text";
  } else {
    document.getElementById("feedback").textContent = "完成！下次可以再試吓少啲錯。";
    document.getElementById("feedback").className = "feedback wrong-text";
  }

  if (currentQuestionIndex >= questions.length - 1) {
    document.getElementById("next-button").textContent = "睇結果";
  } else {
    document.getElementById("next-button").textContent = "下一題";
  }

  document.getElementById("next-button").style.display = "inline-block";
}

function nextQuestion() {
  currentQuestionIndex = currentQuestionIndex + 1;

  if (currentQuestionIndex >= questions.length) {
    showResult();
  } else {
    showQuestion();
  }
}

function showResult() {
  document.getElementById("start-page").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("game-page").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("result-page").style.display = "block";

  document.getElementById("result-score").textContent =
    "完全冇錯：" + perfectScore + " / " + questions.length + " 款湯";

  if (perfectScore === questions.length) {
    document.getElementById("result-note").textContent = "好叻！全部湯料都記得晒。";
  } else {
    document.getElementById("result-note").textContent = "做得好！可以再玩一次幫手記熟啲。";
  }

  createSummary();
}

function createSummary() {
  const summaryDiv = document.getElementById("summary");

  let html = "";
  html += '<div class="summary-title">湯水材料答案</div>';

  soups.forEach(function(soup) {
    html += '<div class="summary-item">';
    html += '<div class="summary-soup">' + soup.name + '</div>';
    html += '<div class="summary-ingredients">' + soup.ingredients.join("、") + '</div>';
    html += '</div>';
  });

  summaryDiv.innerHTML = html;
}

function restartGame() {
  document.getElementById("start-page").style.display = "block";
  document.getElementById("game-page").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("result-page").style.display = "none";
}
</script>
~~~~
